scope: Official IDX announcement search/index surface and retained linked-file checks; bounded event and timing research only

date_filter_probe.interpretation: bounded failure; not used to claim date-range completeness

timing_evidence.conclusion: Publication metadata and document-stated effective date are distinct fields; never substitute one for the other.

what_is_proven: The ordinary public endpoint returns structured announcement IDs, announcement numbers, publish timestamps, codes, and attachment links for bounded keyword searches.
The classification query returns three exchange-wide packages and eight company-specific records.
The 2024-2026 exchange-wide packages add no new annual payload beyond the previously retained official sector archive because their bytes match exactly.
At least four company-specific documents state an effective date of 24 June 2024 while their API records carry a 22 January 2025 publish timestamp.
Attachment URLs are not self-authenticating: some return 403 HTML bodies and several successful links have an identical PDF hash.

Lifecycle keyword semantics are mixed: two of four Pencatatan Kembali results concern board/officer structure, and Penghapusan Pencatatan mixes treasury/security cancellations, go-private plans, and explicit listing events.

Announcement counts are not event or issuer-transition counts: the 182 Perubahan Nama results contain 108 unique codes with 43 repeated codes and 11 Broker records, while the 175 Penggabungan results contain 71 unique codes with 32 repeated codes.
what_remains_unknown: complete historical announcement coverage across dates and keyword variants
daily PIT membership, survivorship, delisting, relisting, and ticker-reuse completeness
whether every downstream market or index field adopts the document-stated effective date
row-level available-at/knowledge time and revision/vintage semantics

admission.allowed_use: bounded event discovery, publication-vs-effective timing audit, and source-design research
admission.forbidden_use: complete lifecycle substitution, daily PIT membership inference, silent effective-date imputation, or predictive admission
